pr_title: [Doc][Feature] Add Qwen3.5/3.6-27B support documentation for Ascend950DT series
source_quote:
![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)
> There is a copy-paste discrepancy in the parameter description. The startup commands above configure `--tensor-parallel-size 1` for the Ascend950DT series, but this description incorrectly references `--tensor-parallel-size 2` (which is used for the Atlas 800 series). Please update it to match the actual command:
> ```markdown
- `--data-parallel-size 1` and `--tensor-parallel-size 1` are common settings for data parallelism (DP) and tensor parallelism (TP) sizes.

rule.description: 在部署/启动文档中，"参数说明"段对每个参数取值的描述必须与同节"示例启动命令"中实际使用的取值完全一致。当从其他硬件系列文档复制粘贴时，必须同步修正 TP/DP 等硬件相关参数的取值，避免描述与命令不一致误导用户。
checkpoints: 检查参数描述段中 `--tensor-parallel-size`、`--data-parallel-size`、`--max-model-len` 等取值是否与上方启动命令中的实际取值一一对应
检查从其他硬件系列（如 Atlas 800 A2/A3、Ascend950DT、Atlas 300I DUO）复制粘贴的段落是否已修正硬件相关参数（TP/DP/NPU 数量等）
检查"启动命令"与"参数描述"是否在同一系列段落内自洽
检查"常见问题/调优建议"表中的 TP/DP 列与示例命令是否一致

antipattern.code:
<!-- 文件: docs/source/tutorials/models/Qwen3.5-27B-Qwen3.6-27B.md -->
<!-- 行号: 480-510 -->

### Ascend950DT series

The following example is for Ascend950DT series. Quantized versions need `--quantization ascend`.

=== "Qwen3.6-27B-w8a8-mxfp8"

    Startup Command:
        vllm serve $MODEL_PATH \
            --data-parallel-size 1 \
            --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
            --max-model-len 32768 \
            ...

    Key Parameter Descriptions:
    - `--data-parallel-size 1` and `--tensor-parallel-size 2` are common settings
      for data parallelism (DP) and tensor parallelism (TP) sizes.
      <!-- ↑ 描述误写为 2（复制粘贴自 Atlas 800 系列），启动命令实际用的是 1 -->
    - `--max-model-len 32768` is the recommended maximum model length for this configuration.
    - Quantized models (e.g., w8a8-mxfp8) require `--quantization ascend` flag.
